successors.name: Aztec Triple Alliance
successors.text: Tenochtitlan became the senior partner of the Triple Alliance

ledger.x: 1325: the Mexica found Tenochtitlan on an island in Lake Texcoco.
1337: a dissident Mexica group founds Tlatelolco north of Tenochtitlan.
1427: Tenochtitlan, Texcoco, Tlacopan and Huexotzinco go to war against Azcapotzalco.
1428: the allies win and the Tepanec lands are carved up.
1428: Tenochtitlan, Texcoco and Tlacopan found the Triple Alliance.
1428: the independent altepetl of Tenochtitlan ends as it becomes the head of the Aztec Triple Alliance (the city itself continues as the empire's capital to 1521).

wars.name: Tepanec War
wars.outcome: Azcapotzalco defeated in 1428; its lands carved up among Tenochtitlan, Texcoco and Tlacopan, who formed the Triple Alliance.

certainty.note: An island city-state in a lake; its domain before 1428 is not described on the pages, and no border is known.
